newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower in consolidation.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower in consolidation.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower as the market consolidated after recent volatility, traders said.
"This was a day where we took stock of all the changes in basis that we've had in recent days. Folks tried to make sense of what the funds have been doing," a trader said.
"We tended to be heavy most of the day -- we reluctantly rallied when the beans rose early...and then we sold that down quickly when the beans fell back," the trader said.
Traders said heavy fund- and hedge-related activity was not evident Wednesday.
MGE spring wheat closed 2-3/4 to five cents per bushel lower, with March down 4-3/4 cents at $4.00-1/2. May lost five cents to close at $3.81.
U.S. wheat markets also drew pressure from reminders of stiff export competition and confirmation that Canada was railing wheat to be shipped through a U.S. port.
Atwood/Peavey was said to be a strong buyer of the March/May spread.
MGE barley futures closed unchanged to one cent per cwt lower, with March down one cent at $6.59.
